en: A monochrome panoramic view of a small European town nestled in a hilly, rural landscape. Dense clusters of houses with pitched roofs, factory chimneys, church spires, and a few larger institutional buildings fill the valley, while scattered houses and fields extend up the surrounding hills. The image has an old printed-photograph style and a caption in the upper left corner that reads "Sebnitz, Sächs. Schweiz." indicating the town and region.
